EXPLANATION: Strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2946/2887 cm⁻¹ and a prominent CH₂ scissoring band at 1450 cm⁻¹ fit a saturated alkyl amine. The intense 771 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with CH₂ rocking in aliphatic chains, and the 919 cm⁻¹ feature matches methyl rocking/skeletal motions. The cluster at 1057–1163 cm⁻¹ suits C–N/C–C skeletal modes in a tertiary amine. Absence of diagnostic bands for isocyanate (~2270 cm⁻¹), diazo/N≡N (~2100–2300 cm⁻¹), O–H (~3200–3600 cm⁻¹), Si–H (~2100–2200 cm⁻¹), or aromatic C=C (~1600 cm⁻¹) disfavors other candidates. Overall, CCN(CC)CC best matches the observed Raman pattern.
